mapper.sql: wh.id, wh.user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), u.username) as user_name, wh.project_id, p.name as project_name, wh.task_id, t.title as task_name, wh.work_date, wh.hours, wh.content, wh.record_type, wh.leave_type_id, lt.name as leave_type_name, wh.status, wh.create_user_id, wh.update_user_id, wh.create_time, wh.update_time, wh.is_deleted

LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON wh.user_id = u.id AND u.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN gsms_project p ON wh.project_id = p.id AND p.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN gsms_task t ON wh.task_id = t.id AND t.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN gsms_leave_type lt ON wh.leave_type_id = lt.id AND lt.is_deleted = 0
AND wh.is_deleted = 0 AND ( wh.record_type = 2 OR (wh.project_id IS NOT NULL AND p.id IS NOT NULL) )
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM gsms_work_hour wh
WHERE wh.project_id = #{projectId} AND wh.record_type = 1
ORDER BY wh.work_date DESC, wh.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gsms_work_hour(user_id, project_id, task_id, work_date, hours, content, record_type, leave_type_id, status, create_user_id, update_user_id) VALUES(#{userId}, #{projectId}, #{taskId}, #{workDate}, #{hours}, #{content}, #{recordType, typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.core.handlers.MybatisEnumTypeHandler}, #{leaveTypeId}, #{status, typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.core.handlers.MybatisEnumTypeHandler}, #{createUserId}, #{updateUserId})
mapper.update: UPDATE gsms_work_hour SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE gsms_work_hour SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND is_deleted = 0
